note: Trigger for meas-long-probe.yml (9.5 D35, D42): a long-phase probe of an application's idle or play phase, never a campaign repeat. A push that changes this file starts the runs it names. apps and repeats (a map app -> probe indices) as in the other triggers; phase_s: each application's phase length in seconds, design, stated in the method before its launch. 9.10 D143-D145: an index listed under driven runs probe-driven - the campaign's settle and idle phase, then windows[app] driven windows of window_s seconds back to back.
